paper_title: First results from BRASS-p broadband searches for hidden photon dark matter
notes: Hidden photon (dark photon) DM search via conversion at conducting surface. Mass range 49.63-74.44 ueV (12-18 GHz). Reported record 1-sigma detection sensitivity chi ~ (0.3-1.0)x10^-13 over the range; the exclusion is essentially a broadband band near 1e-13. Values are approximate reads from text/Fig.11-12 (only endpoints and best value quoted). Result is a 1-sigma sensitivity rather than a formal 90/95% CL exclusion. rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
